responsibility: Declares accessors for compiler default settings sourced from the environment, specifically the default module search path and default command-line options. It isolates the rest of gm2 from direct environment-variable handling for `M2PATH` and `M2OPTIONS`.
same_name_distinction: This definition module is the public contract for retrieving gm2 defaults, exporting only `GetSearchPath` and `GetOptions` without exposing how they are obtained. The companion `M2Defaults.mod` performs the actual environment lookups for `M2PATH` and `M2OPTIONS`.
